DisplayName.value: Kitsune Loads ~ Cats of 7 Days: Lunar New Year

Description.value: Cats of 7 Days, the Lunar New Year special: Kevin the tabby sees in the new year under red lanterns while the zombies crash the party. 12 widescreen scenes (lanterns at the trader, zombie lion dance, firecrackers, dumplings, red envelopes, the new year door, scrap dragon, fireworks, minibike in the blossoms, plum tree nap, hot pot, blood moon) rotate at random every time the loading screen appears. Mutually exclusive with the other KitsuneLoads packs ~ install one or the other.
